common.daysAgo: {n, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
common.observationalNote: These are observational figures from our own users, not trial results. People who choose a structured programme and stay with it differ systematically from those who do not. We report what our users experienced; we do not claim the programme caused it.

flagText.review: Flagged for clinician review: the algorithmic stage placement had low confidence, so a person needs to confirm or change it before the programme continues.
flagText.safety: Flagged: the assessment raised a safety flag and the patient chose to continue anyway. Worth confirming that the programme is still the right thing for them.
flagText.inactive: Flagged: no session logged for more than 10 days. The action here is to ask whether the programme needs changing, not to send a reminder about commitment.

content.twoPersonRule: Two-person rule. No clinical content publishes without a named author and a named second-clinician reviewer, and every article carries a review date on the page. Anything older than six months is flagged for re-review whether the science moved or not.

analytics.sessionsByStageChart: Share of days with a session logged, by stage
analytics.sessionsByStageNote: Mean of each patient's last 28 days (or fewer, for patients newer than that).
analytics.stage3Note: Stage 3 is the coordination stage, where the numbers move slowly — and it is where we put the most clinician contact for exactly that reason.
analytics.medianChange: Median symmetry score change by starting stage
analytics.medianChangeNote: Change over 90 days, in score points. Stage 5 sitting near zero is expected — maintenance is not meant to move the number.
analytics.scanNote: Scan results are not stored on the server yet, so this chart still shows the prototype's figures.

attn.safetySub: Each one should have a clinician confirm the programme is still right for them.

attn.inactiveSub: The action is to ask what changed, never to send guilt.

attn.unassignedSub: Assign them on the Users tab.

attn.invitationsSub: Revoke or resend them on the Invite page.

clinicians.empty: No clinicians yet. Invite one to get started.
clinicians.verificationNote: Verification is manual. Every registration number is checked by hand against the regulator's public register before a clinician is verified. A suspended clinician loses access to their patients straight away.
clinicians.qualityNote: Measured on what patients report afterwards, not on call volume. We do not incentivise clinicians on throughput.

patients.accessNote: Access is scoped. Operations staff see clinical progress under initials; full identity and contact details are shown only to the clinician assigned to that patient.
patients.noFlagged: No patients are flagged right now.
patients.sortingNote: No column here ranks patients against each other, and there is no leaderboard view. Symmetry scores are not shown because scan results are not stored on the server yet.

detail.title: {name} · {id}
detail.privacyNote: Staff can see clinical progress, not identity. Names are initialised and contact details are not exposed here. Full records are visible only to the clinician assigned to the patient.

content.machineNote: Machine-drafted clinical content is never published. A clinician who reads the language signs it off or it stays unpublished.

analytics.dropoffNote: Percent of cohort. The trial figure is the honest one — a fifth of the people who start decide within seven days that this is not for them, which is exactly what a free trial is for.
analytics.lightingNote: Uneven side lighting is the single most common cause of a rejected scan, which is why the guidance on that screen leads with it rather than burying it.

finance.planMixNote: Paying and trialling subscriptions. The middle plan being the largest is why it is labelled "most chosen" on the pricing page — a description, not a nudge, and nothing is pre-selected.
finance.revenueNote: Thousands of euro, recognised across the three-month term rather than at the point of sale.
finance.stripeNote: All payments run through Stripe. We never see or store a card number. Refund requests inside the first 14 days of a paid term are approved without a reason being given.
finance.reducedCostNote: Held for people who cannot afford the programme. One sentence about their situation is all we ask for.

compliance.slaNote: Statutory deadline is one month. Our internal target is seven days.

postureRows.subProcessorsValue: 4 · all EU or with adequacy decisions

compliance.auditLogNote: Role changes, assignments, stage changes and notes are written here. It is append-only and staff cannot delete from it.
compliance.safetyEmpty: No safety flags raised this month.
compliance.safetyNote: {n, plural, one {# safety flag} other {# safety flags}} raised at assessment this month. Each one is a sign-up we stopped to check on rather than let through. The number is reported at board level every month for exactly that reason.

meta.description: Edit, preview and publish the text shown on the website.

text.heading: Website text
text.subtitle: Change the wording on the site. Edits are saved as drafts, which only admins can preview, until you publish them.
text.count: {n, plural, one {# piece of text} other {# pieces of text}} · {drafts, plural, =0 {no drafts} one {# draft} other {# drafts}} on this page
text.publishAll: Publish {n, plural, =0 {drafts} one {# draft} other {all # drafts}}
text.howTo: Save draft keeps your change private; Preview drafts shows the real site with your drafts, only to you; Publish makes it live for everyone straight away. Keep anything in curly braces such as '{name}' and tags such as '…' exactly as they are — the site fills those in.

result.saved: Draft saved. Only admins previewing drafts can see it.
result.published: Published. Everyone sees the new text now.
result.publishedAll: {count, plural, =0 {There were no drafts to publish.} one {# draft published.} other {# drafts published.}}

error.forbidden: You don't have permission to edit the website text.
error.invalid_input: Something was missing from that request. Please try again.
error.unknown_key: That text no longer exists on the site.
error.too_long: That text is too long (5,000 characters at most).
error.empty: The text can't be empty. Use “Revert to original” to undo an edit.
error.bad_syntax: The text has a formatting problem, usually an unmatched curly brace or tag.
error.placeholders_changed: The placeholders in curly braces must stay the same as the original.
error.tags_changed: The formatting tags (the parts in angle brackets) must stay the same as the original.

text.auditLink: Every save, publish and revert is recorded in the audit log.

banner.title: Previewing drafts
banner.body: You're seeing unpublished text. Visitors see the published version.
